node.title: Tangent staircase compiler (#147)
node.statement: [transcribed 2026-07-27 from the upstream source read via git -C ../rs-mca show origin/main:experimental/notes/roadmaps/proof_sketch/s2_paid_ledger.md#1, tagged 'statuses per component'; the tangent line is PROVED-cited (#147 staircase range)]. THE TANGENT STAIRCASE RANGE: for a row (n, k, q = q_line) at exact agreement A (t = A-k, j = n-A), the tangent term satisfies B_tan(A) <= n - A + 1. SCOPE: at prize scale n <= 2^41 << B* ~ 2^128 this term NEVER binds; at small q it is the whole story (the 506/507 pinned row). The load-bearing quotient term B_quot(A) is a different component of the same ledger and is NOT claimed here.
